data.narrative:
Singularity, a Series A defense and security company that has raised $82M to date, is valued at $400M post-money by its last financing. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 companies in the Defense & Security sector at Series A and adjacent stages, including 8 private firms (notably Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI) and 2 public comparables (DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer universe ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $800M. Peer-median analysis across the 10 same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with the peer set including recent Series B financings at Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The triangulated valuation range is $680M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $900M. The current $400M post-money represents approximately 44% of the median implied value. Key uncertainties include the pace of market adoption in the defense sector, regulatory approval timelines, and relative competitive positioning within a maturing frontier-tech cohort.
